title: NL2SQL with Iterative Self-Refinement
title_zh: 基于迭代自我修正的自然语言转SQL技术

paragraphs.en: Bridging the gap between human intent and machine logic remains a critical challenge in data access for non-technical users, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) remain unreliable: they hallucinate schema elements, generate syntactically invalid queries, or fail to capture user intent. These limitations are especially critical in domains such as insurance, where KPIs, regulatory constraints, and legacy relational systems demand high precision. We introduce a multi-agent, persona-driven NL2SQL framework that combines (1) domain relevance detection, (2) schema-grounded knowledge construction, (3) KPI-aware SQL synthesis, (4) syntax-level self-repair using sqlite execution feedback, and (5) semantic consistency checking via SQL-to-NL reverse engineering. Our system significantly reduces query hallucination and improves semantic fidelity compared to direct LLM prompting. Evaluated on 60 queries (50 from a HuggingFace text-to-SQL dataset and 10 custom domain queries), the system achieves 90% correctness using Mistral across seven coordinated LLM calls showing that this approach can substantially increase the reliability of NL2SQL pipelines in high-stakes environments.
paragraphs.zh: 弥合人类意图与机器逻辑之间的差距，仍然是非技术用户数据访问中的一项关键挑战，然而大语言模型（LLM）依然不可靠：它们会产生幻觉的 schema 元素、生成语法无效的查询，或无法准确捕捉用户意图。 这些局限性在保险等领域尤为关键，因为 KPI、监管约束以及遗留关系型系统都要求极高的精确度。 我们提出了一种多智能体、基于角色设定的 NL2SQL 框架，该框架结合了：（1）领域相关性检测，（2）基于 schema 的知识构建，（3）KPI 感知的 SQL 合成，（4）利用 sqlite 执行反馈进行语法层面的自我修复，以及（5）通过 SQL 到 NL 的逆向工程进行语义一致性检查。 与直接使用 LLM 提示相比，我们的系统显著减少了查询幻觉并提升了语义保真度。 在 60 个查询（其中 50 个来自 HuggingFace 的 text-to-SQL 数据集，10 个为自定义领域查询）上进行评估，该系统通过 Mistral 在七次协同的 LLM 调用中达到了 90% 的正确率，这表明该方法能够大幅提升 NL2SQL 流水线在高风险环境中的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: The insurance industry operates on complex, data-intensive processes that rely heavily on structured information about policies, claims, customers, agents, and submissions. These datasets carry critical business functions, including pricing, underwriting, fraud detection, portfolio analysis, and KPI-driven performance monitoring. Although insurers store decades of transactional data in relational databases, this information is often locked behind SQL interfaces accessible only to technically trained analysts. As a result, underwriters, financial planners, and operations teams depend on technical intermediaries to obtain even basic metrics, delaying decisions in a domain where timing and accuracy are crucial.
paragraphs.zh: 保险业运行在复杂、数据密集的流程之上，这些流程高度依赖于关于保单、理赔、客户、智能体和投保申请的结构化信息。 这些数据集承载着关键的业务功能，包括定价、承保、欺诈检测、投资组合分析以及基于 KPI 的绩效监控。 尽管保险公司将数十年的交易数据存储在关系型数据库中，但这些信息往往被封锁在 SQL 接口之后，只有受过技术训练的分析师才能访问。 因此，核保人员、财务规划师和运营团队即便要获取最基本的指标，也不得不依赖技术中介，从而在一个时机与准确性至关重要的领域中延误了决策。

paragraphs.en: Despite increasing adoption of AI tools, querying these legacy systems remains challenging [ 13 ] . Their schemas are domain-specific, include numerous interlinked tables, and require precise understanding of insurance KPIs such as loss ratios or claim frequencies. Modern LLMs like ChatGPT can translate natural language into SQL, but they frequently hallucinate table or column names, produce syntactically invalid queries, or generate outputs misaligned with business intent. Such unreliability makes them unsuitable for high-stakes industries like insurance, where incorrect queries can lead to flawed reports, mispriced risk, or regulatory compliance issues.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管AI工具的采用日益增多，查询这些遗留系统仍然具有挑战性[13]。 它们的模式是领域特定的，包含大量相互关联的表，并且需要对损失率或理赔频率等保险KPI有精确的理解。 像ChatGPT这样的现代大语言模型可以将自然语言转换为SQL，但它们经常产生幻觉式的表名或列名、生成语法无效的查询，或产生与业务意图不一致的输出。 这种不可靠性使其不适合保险等高风险行业，因为在这些行业中，错误的查询可能导致有缺陷的报告、错误定价的风险或监管合规问题。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we develop a multi-agent, persona-driven NL2SQL system tailored for insurance databases. Our approach integrates (1) domain-relevance validation to ensure user queries align with insurance concepts (2) schema-grounded knowledge generation [ 6 ] , including KPI decomposition (3) iterative SQL correction using sqlite-based syntax checks and (4) semantic validation via SQL-to-NL reverse engineering paired with LLM-as-a-judge comparison. By combining domain expertise, guided decomposition, and error-correcting feedback loops, our system produces SQL that is both syntactically correct and semantically faithful to user intent. Through this structured methodology, we demonstrate that reliable natural-language querying of legacy insurance databases is achievable, overcoming the limitations of direct LLM prompting and enabling decision-makers to access critical insights without technical barriers.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们开发了一个面向保险数据库的多智能体、角色驱动的 NL2SQL 系统。 我们的方法集成了以下四点：(1) 领域相关性验证，确保用户查询与保险概念一致；(2) 基于模式的知识生成 [ 6 ]，包括 KPI 分解；(3) 基于 sqlite 的语法检查进行迭代式 SQL 修正；(4) 通过 SQL 到自然语言（NL）的逆向工程并结合 LLM-as-a-judge 对比进行语义验证。 通过结合领域专业知识、引导式分解以及纠错反馈循环，我们的系统生成的 SQL 在语法上正确，同时在语义上忠实于用户意图。 借助这一结构化方法，我们证明了对传统保险数据库进行可靠的自然语言查询是可行的，克服了直接使用大语言模型提示的局限性，使决策者无需技术门槛即可获取关键洞见。

sents.en: To address these challenges, we develop a multi-agent, persona-driven NL2SQL system tailored for insurance databases.
sents.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们开发了一个面向保险数据库的多智能体、角色驱动的 NL2SQL 系统。

sents.en: Our approach integrates (1) domain-relevance validation to ensure user queries align with insurance concepts (2) schema-grounded knowledge generation [ 6 ] , including KPI decomposition (3) iterative SQL correction using sqlite-based syntax checks and (4) semantic validation via SQL-to-NL reverse engineering paired with LLM-as-a-judge comparison.

sents.en: By combining domain expertise, guided decomposition, and error-correcting feedback loops, our system produces SQL that is both syntactically correct and semantically faithful to user intent.

paragraphs.en: Research in text-to-SQL has evolved through specialized architectures, prompting strategies, and evaluation frameworks aimed at improving the reliability of NL2SQL systems. Early work focused on neural architectures that explicitly model schema-linking and relational structures. For example, RAT-SQL [ 10 ] introduced a relation-aware encoder that aligns natural-language queries with database schemas through semantic linking, achieving strong performance on cross-domain benchmarks. This class of models demonstrates the importance of grounding language understanding in structural representations of the database.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到SQL的研究经历了专门化架构、提示策略以及旨在提升NL2SQL系统可靠性的评估框架的演进。 早期工作聚焦于显式建模模式链接与关系结构的神经架构。 例如，RAT-SQL [ 10 ] 提出了一种关系感知编码器，通过语义链接将自然语言查询与数据库模式对齐，在跨域基准测试中取得了优异表现。 这类模型表明，将语言理解扎根于数据库的结构化表示之中十分重要。

sents.en: Research in text-to-SQL has evolved through specialized architectures, prompting strategies, and evaluation frameworks aimed at improving the reliability of NL2SQL systems.
sents.zh: 文本到SQL的研究经历了专门化架构、提示策略以及旨在提升NL2SQL系统可靠性的评估框架的演进。

sents.zh: 早期工作聚焦于显式建模模式链接与关系结构的神经架构。

paragraphs.en: As large language models (LLMs) became more prominent, prompting strategies emerged as a practical alternative to heavy model training. Techniques such as Divide-and-Prompt and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting [ 8 ] have shown that breaking NL queries into smaller reasoning steps can improve SQL generation accuracy. These methods emphasize guiding the model toward intermediate reasoning, reducing some forms of hallucination and strengthening schema awareness.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的重要性日益凸显，提示策略成为一种替代繁重模型训练的实用方案。 分治提示（Divide-and-Prompt）和思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）提示 [ 8 ] 等技术表明，将自然语言查询拆分为更小的推理步骤可以提高 SQL 生成的准确性。 这些方法强调引导模型进行中间推理，从而减少某些形式的幻觉并增强对模式的感知能力。

sents.en: As large language models (LLMs) became more prominent, prompting strategies emerged as a practical alternative to heavy model training.
sents.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的重要性日益凸显，提示策略成为一种替代繁重模型训练的实用方案。

sents.en: Techniques such as Divide-and-Prompt and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting [ 8 ] have shown that breaking NL queries into smaller reasoning steps can improve SQL generation accuracy.
sents.zh: 分治提示（Divide-and-Prompt）和思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）提示 [ 8 ] 等技术表明，将自然语言查询拆分为更小的推理步骤可以提高 SQL 生成的准确性。

paragraphs.en: It is necessary to use evaluation frameworks such as LLM-as-a-Judge or SQL2NL [ 7 ] comparison to provide more reliable assessments of semantic equivalence than simple string matching. These methods compare the intent of the NL query with the intent expressed by the generated SQL, offering a closer proxy for actual correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 有必要使用诸如 LLM-as-a-Judge 或 SQL2NL [7] 对比等评估框架，以提供比简单字符串匹配更可靠的语义等价性评估。 这些方法将自然语言查询的意图与生成的 SQL 所表达的意图进行对比，从而更接近实际正确性的代理指标。

sents.zh: 这些方法将自然语言查询的意图与生成的 SQL 所表达的意图进行对比，从而更接近实际正确性的代理指标。

paragraphs.en: However, even with advanced prompting, generating accurate SQL remains difficult. The base paper influencing our work is SQL-of-Thought [ 1 ] which proposed a multi-agent, error-correcting pipeline where LLMs iteratively refine SQL queries based on execution feedback but this approach only relied on syntactic correctness of the generated query.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，即使采用先进的提示技术，生成准确的 SQL 仍然很困难。 影响我们工作的基础论文是 SQL-of-Thought [ 1 ]，该论文提出了一个多智能体、可纠错的流水线，其中大语言模型（LLM）基于执行反馈迭代地改进 SQL 查询，但这种方法仅依赖于生成查询的语法正确性。

sents.zh: 然而，即使采用先进的提示技术，生成准确的 SQL 仍然很困难。

sents.en: The base paper influencing our work is SQL-of-Thought [ 1 ] which proposed a multi-agent, error-correcting pipeline where LLMs iteratively refine SQL queries based on execution feedback but this approach only relied on syntactic correctness of the generated query.

paragraphs.en: Unlike prior NL2SQL systems that rely solely on schema-linking architectures, prompting techniques, or single-pass SQL generation, our approach introduces a persona-driven, KPI-aware, multi-stage correction pipeline specifically tailored for the insurance domain. We extend beyond traditional parsing by incorporating domain relevance filtering, explicit knowledge generation (including tables, columns, and KPI formulas), and a guided refinement loop that uses both syntactic validation through SQLite execution and semantic validation via SQL-to-NL reverse engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 与之前仅依赖模式链接架构、提示技术或单次SQL生成的NL2SQL系统不同，我们的方法引入了一种面向角色、KPI感知、多阶段纠错的流水线，专门针对保险领域而设计。 我们超越了传统的解析方法，通过引入领域相关性过滤、显式知识生成（包括表、列和KPI公式），以及一个引导式优化循环来实现，该循环同时利用基于SQLite执行的语法验证和基于SQL到自然语言逆向工程的语义验证。

sents.en: Unlike prior NL2SQL systems that rely solely on schema-linking architectures, prompting techniques, or single-pass SQL generation, our approach introduces a persona-driven, KPI-aware, multi-stage correction pipeline specifically tailored for the insurance domain.
sents.zh: 与之前仅依赖模式链接架构、提示技术或单次SQL生成的NL2SQL系统不同，我们的方法引入了一种面向角色、KPI感知、多阶段纠错的流水线，专门针对保险领域而设计。

paragraphs.en: The database models a standard insurance lifecycle, comprising five core relational entities that track the customer journey from lead acquisition to policy management and claims processing.

paragraphs.en: To strictly bound the model’s reasoning and mitigate the hallucination of non-existent columns or incorrect metric derivations, we augmented the input context with two structured metadata dictionaries.
paragraphs.zh: 为了严格约束模型的推理，并缓解对不存在的列或错误的指标推导产生幻觉的问题，我们用两个结构化的元数据字典增强了输入上下文。

paragraphs.en: KPI Dictionary: To ensure mathematical precision, we embedded a predefined dictionary of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that maps industry terms to their exact formulae. Instead of relying on the LLM’s knowledge to define metrics such as “loss ratio” or “conversion rate,” the system retrieves explicit formulas (e.g., Quote Conversion = Count(Bound) Count(Quoted) \text{Quote Conversion}=\frac{\text{Count(Bound)}}{\text{Count(Quoted)}} ). This ensures that aggregate metrics align with business logic rather than probabilistic approximations. Few example KPIs are shown below:
paragraphs.zh: KPI 字典：为确保数学上的精确性，我们嵌入了一个预定义的关键绩效指标（KPI）字典，将行业术语映射到其确切的公式。 系统并不依赖大语言模型（LLM）的知识来定义诸如「损失率」或「转化率」等指标，而是检索明确的公式（例如，报价转化率 = 已成交数/报价数 \text{Quote Conversion}=\frac{\text{Count(Bound)}}{\text{Count(Quoted)}}）。 这确保了聚合指标符合业务逻辑，而非概率性的近似。 以下是几个 KPI 示例：

paragraphs.en: We define the Text-to-SQL task as the generation of an executable SQL query s s given a natural language query q q and a database schema S S . Unlike standard one-shot generation approaches, we model this process as a multi-stage iterative system, as shown in 2 comprising an initial generation phase followed by a self-refinement loop driven by dual feedback mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Text-to-SQL 任务定义为：在给定自然语言查询 q q 和数据库模式 S S 的情况下，生成可执行的 SQL 查询 s s。 与标准的单次生成方法不同，我们将该过程建模为一个多阶段迭代系统，如 2 所示，其由初始生成阶段和随后由双重反馈机制驱动的自我精炼循环组成。

sents.en: We define the Text-to-SQL task as the generation of an executable SQL query s s given a natural language query q q and a database schema S S .
sents.zh: 我们将 Text-to-SQL 任务定义为：在给定自然语言查询 q q 和数据库模式 S S 的情况下，生成可执行的 SQL 查询 s s。

sents.en: Unlike standard one-shot generation approaches, we model this process as a multi-stage iterative system, as shown in 2 comprising an initial generation phase followed by a self-refinement loop driven by dual feedback mechanisms.
sents.zh: 与标准的单次生成方法不同，我们将该过程建模为一个多阶段迭代系统，如 2 所示，其由初始生成阶段和随后由双重反馈机制驱动的自我精炼循环组成。

This function utilizes an intermediate knowledge representation K ⁡ ( q , S ) K(q,S) , comprising relevant tables, columns, and KPI formulas derived from the schema S S rather than mapping directly from q q .

paragraphs.en: To ensure both syntactic correctness and semantic alignment, the system enters a Refinement Step [ 4 ] , denoted as f ref f_{\text{ref}} . This process iteratively updates the SQL query s t s_{t} at step t t by incorporating feedback from two distinct error reflection functions: E syn E_{\text{syn}} (syntax error reflection) and E log E_{\text{log}} (logical error reflection).
paragraphs.zh: 为了同时确保句法正确性和语义对齐，系统会进入一个细化步骤 [ 4 ]，记作 f ref f_{\text{ref}} 。 该过程通过融合两个不同的错误反思函数的反馈，在步骤 t t 处迭代更新 SQL 查询 s t s_{t}：E syn E_{\text{syn}}（语法错误反思）和 E log E_{\text{log}}（逻辑错误反思）。

paragraphs.en: This formulation ensures that s t + 1 s_{t+1} is strictly conditioned on the specific failure modes of s t s_{t} , allowing the model to converge toward a solution that is both executable and semantically faithful to the user’s intent.
paragraphs.zh: 该公式确保 s t + 1 s_{t+1} 严格以 s t s_{t} 的特定失败模式为条件，使模型能够收敛到一个既可执行又在语义上忠实于用户意图的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: In the logical error analysis phase, the system evaluates the semantic correctness of the generated SQL query using a reverse engineering strategy. Specifically, the SQL query is translated back into a structured natural language description that captures its intent, constraints, and aggregation logic. This generated explanation is then systematically compared against the user’s original natural language query using an LLM-as-a-Judge [ 12 ] mechanism, where a large language model scores semantic alignment between the two representations.
paragraphs.zh: 在逻辑错误分析阶段，系统采用逆向工程策略评估所生成SQL查询的语义正确性。 具体而言，SQL查询会被翻译回结构化的自然语言描述，以捕捉其意图、约束和聚合逻辑。 然后，通过LLM-as-a-Judge [ 12 ]机制，利用大语言模型对这一生成的解释与用户的原始自然语言查询进行系统性比较，由大语言模型对两种表示之间的语义一致性进行打分。

sents.en: In the logical error analysis phase, the system evaluates the semantic correctness of the generated SQL query using a reverse engineering strategy.
sents.zh: 在逻辑错误分析阶段，系统采用逆向工程策略评估所生成SQL查询的语义正确性。

sents.en: Specifically, the SQL query is translated back into a structured natural language description that captures its intent, constraints, and aggregation logic.
sents.zh: 具体而言，SQL查询会被翻译回结构化的自然语言描述，以捕捉其意图、约束和聚合逻辑。

sents.en: This generated explanation is then systematically compared against the user’s original natural language query using an LLM-as-a-Judge [ 12 ] mechanism, where a large language model scores semantic alignment between the two representations.
sents.zh: 然后，通过LLM-as-a-Judge [ 12 ]机制，利用大语言模型对这一生成的解释与用户的原始自然语言查询进行系统性比较，由大语言模型对两种表示之间的语义一致性进行打分。

paragraphs.en: If the reverse-engineered description is judged to be semantically consistent with the user’s intent, the SQL query is executed against the target database and the results are returned. If a semantic mismatch is detected, the system automatically triggers a correction routine that produces a revised SQL query. This corrected query is fed back into a self-refinement loop, enabling iterative improvement through repeated generation, validation, and repair. This feedback-driven process helps prevent silent logical failures, reduces hallucinated joins or filters, and ensures that the final query reflects both the syntactic structure and the semantic intent of the user’s request.
paragraphs.zh: 如果逆向工程得到的描述被判定为与用户意图在语义上一致，则针对目标数据库执行该 SQL 查询并返回结果。 如果检测到语义不匹配，系统会自动触发一个纠错流程，生成修订后的 SQL 查询。 这个修正后的查询会被反馈到一个自我精炼的循环中，通过反复的生成、验证和修复实现迭代改进。 这种由反馈驱动的过程有助于防止静默的逻辑失败，减少幻觉产生的连接或过滤条件，并确保最终查询既反映句法结构，也反映用户请求的语义意图。

paragraphs.en: Our experimental evaluation on a curated set of 60 domain-specific queries comprising 50 instances from gretelai synthetic dataset [ 2 ] and 10 custom KPI based complex queries, achieving an aggregate accuracy of approximately 90%. Performance stratification by task type reveals that the system attains near-perfect reliability (100%) in “Data Retrieval” tasks, which primarily involve direct selection and filtering. In contrast, the more abstract “Analytics and Reporting” scenarios, which require multi-step aggregation and KPI derivation, maintained a robust accuracy of approximately 85%. Furthermore, the model exhibits resilience across varying levels of SQL complexity as shown in 4 , handling basic queries with high precision while maintaining substantial accuracy in generating advanced structures involving subqueries and window functions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在精选的 60 个领域特定查询上进行了实验评估，其中包括来自 gretelai 合成数据集 [ 2 ] 的 50 个实例和 10 个基于自定义 KPI 的复杂查询，总体准确率约为 90%。 按任务类型划分的性能分析显示，系统在主要涉及直接选择和过滤的“数据检索”任务中达到了近乎完美的可靠性（100%）。 相比之下，需要多步聚合和 KPI 推导的更抽象的“分析与报告”场景仍保持了约 85% 的稳健准确率。 此外，如 4 所示，该模型在不同 SQL 复杂度级别上均表现出韧性，能够高精度地处理基础查询，同时在生成涉及子查询和窗口函数的高级结构时保持可观的准确率。

paragraphs.en: This system used many personas in its verification process such as “Insurance Domain Specialist” and “SQL Data Analyst” personas to iteratively tune queries that initially fail execution or logic checks. This multi-agent collaboration ensures that the final output is not only syntactically valid but semantically aligned with complex insurance logic.
paragraphs.zh: 该系统在验证过程中使用了多种角色，例如「保险领域专家」智能体和「SQL 数据分析师」智能体，对最初未能通过执行或逻辑检查的查询进行迭代调优。 这种多智能体协作确保最终输出不仅在语法上有效，而且在语义上符合复杂的保险逻辑。

paragraphs.en: Regarding operational constraints, the framework utilizes the mistral-large-2411 model [ 5 ] to power its reasoning agents. The pipeline consisting of Chain-of-Thought relevance reasoning, knowledge generation, syntax validation, and logical refinement, necessitates an average of 7 LLM calls per query execution. This results in an average end-to-end latency of approximately 20 seconds. While this latency is higher than direct text-to-SQL inference, it produces accurate and reliable queries without hallucinating relations, attribute names, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 关于运行限制，该框架使用 mistral-large-2411 模型 [ 5 ] 来驱动其推理智能体。 该流程由思维链相关性推理、知识生成、语法验证和逻辑修正组成，每次查询执行平均需要 7 次 LLM 调用。 这导致平均端到端延迟约为 20 秒。 虽然该延迟高于直接的文本到 SQL 推理，但它能生成准确可靠的查询，而不会产生关系、属性名等方面的幻觉。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we presented a persona-driven, KPI-aware framework for Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) generation, specifically designed to address the accessibility gap in the insurance domain. By formalizing the generation process as a recursive function with dual-feedback loops, we successfully mitigated common LLM failure modes, including schema hallucination and syntactic invalidity. Our approach, which couples "Generate Knowledge Prompting" (GKP) with a rigorous "Reverse Engineering" validation step through self-refinement, allows non-technical users to reliably query legacy databases without knowledge of the underlying SQL structure. Experimental results demonstrate that this iterative refinement strategy achieves approximately 90% accuracy, proving that agentic workflows can effectively bridge the divide between human intent and machine logic in high-stakes enterprise environments.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一个基于角色画像、感知 KPI 的自然语言转 SQL（NL2SQL）生成框架，专门用于解决保险领域的可及性差距。 通过将生成过程形式化为具有双重反馈循环的递归函数，我们成功缓解了大语言模型的常见失败模式，包括模式幻觉和句法无效性。 我们的方法将「生成知识提示」（GKP）与通过自我优化实现的严格的「逆向工程」验证步骤相结合，使非技术用户能够在不了解底层 SQL 结构的情况下可靠地查询遗留数据库。 实验结果表明，这种迭代优化策略达到了约 90% 的准确率，证明智能体工作流能够有效地在高风险的企业环境中弥合人类意图与机器逻辑之间的鸿沟。

paragraphs.en: While our current implementation establishes a robust baseline, we envision several enhancements to improve the framework’s utility. Future iterations of this work will transition from static prompting to dynamic prompt modulation, automatically adjusting Chain-of-Thought depth and employing few-shot dynamic example selection based on query complexity. Concurrently, we intend to assess model agnosticism by benchmarking across many LLMs ranging from lightweight open-source models to proprietary frontiers to optimize the trade-off between latency, inference cost and reasoning accuracy. Finally, we plan to extend the pipeline’s capabilities beyond mere retrieval by integrating a post-processing agent that summarizes SQL results into actionable natural language insights, thereby transforming the system into a comprehensive decision-support analyst
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们当前的实现建立了一个稳健的基线，但我们设想了若干改进方向以提升该框架的实用性。 本工作的未来迭代将从静态提示转向动态提示调节，根据查询复杂度自动调整思维链的深度，并采用少样本动态示例选择。 同时，我们打算通过在众多大语言模型上进行基准测试来评估模型的无关性，这些模型涵盖从轻量级开源模型到专有前沿模型，以优化延迟、推理成本与推理准确性之间的权衡。 最后，我们计划通过集成一个后处理智能体来扩展该流水线的能力，使其超越单纯的检索，该智能体将把 SQL 结果总结为可操作的自然语言洞察，从而将系统转变为一个综合性的决策支持分析师。
